assumptions: Owners and issue dates remain unset until capacity is confirmed; existing project lead/start/target dates preserved.
Capability epics are Backlog and require child-task refinement before sprint commitment. No speculative effort estimates.
The current first slice is local and uncommitted. Strict TypeScript is locally verified and In Review, not Done or shipped.
Berdua and descendants, Conversation Cards and Jurnal Keluarga are excluded. Restricted child roles are undecided. Automatic recurring posting is P2.
Identity is client-encrypted; readable finance and metadata can reidentify people. No promise of guaranteed anonymity.

milestones.name: 01 · Secure foundation
milestones.description: Integrate and review the locally validated personal-account slice; enforce strict TypeScript, contract parity, key lifecycle, native lifecycle tests and operational controls.

milestones.name: 02 · Household access
milestones.description: Add pseudonymous household roles, intended-recipient invitations and verified client-encrypted sharing. Revocation must stop future server access.

milestones.name: 03 · Ledger and capture
milestones.description: Complete exact-money wallets, transfers, corrections, splits and searchable history with immutable balanced journals.

milestones.name: 04 · Budgets, debts, goals and reports
milestones.description: Deliver trustworthy planning and economic-purpose reports reconciled against the ledger.

milestones.name: 05 · Household workflows and files
milestones.description: Deliver private file/job infrastructure, reviewed recurring entries, groceries, calendar, maintenance, links and import/export.

milestones.name: 06 · Investments and ecosystem
milestones.description: Add investment accounting, allocation, calculators, insights, optional providers, affiliate and help/feedback.

milestones.name: 07 · Pilot and release
milestones.description: Measure security, privacy, accessibility, performance, reliability and signed-distribution evidence before selecting a release.

milestones.name: 08 · Deferred enhancements
milestones.description: Separately gated P2 or optional features; excluded from the core release commitment.

issues.title: [Epic] Review and operationalize the monorepo foundation
issues.outcome: Turn the local Rust/Axum + PostgreSQL/Valkey + OpenAPI, strict Next.js CSR and native Kotlin/Swift implementation into a reviewed reproducible baseline.
acceptance: Keep root /api, /web, /mobile; preserve source ai-analyze artifacts. Use contracts/openapi.json for implemented endpoints; source 154-operation design is future scope.
Require a non-owner/non-BYPASSRLS runtime DB role, owner isolation, exact minor units, balanced immutable journals, idempotency and bounded error payloads.
Demonstrate fresh setup/migrations, cache outage behavior, contract drift checks and remote CI on an actual revision before calling integration complete.
Record deployment and restore procedures, secrets/telemetry redaction, patch policy and declared-workload performance evidence. Local validation is not a deployment claim.

issues.title: [Epic] Complete encrypted identity and account lifecycle
issues.outcome: Keep personal details client-encrypted while readable finance remains scoped to a proven pseudonymous owner.
acceptance: Review key enrollment, recovery, atomic credential rotation, envelope version migration and all-device revocation; reject old credentials after successful rotation.
Implement scoped step-up, session expiry, account reset/delete preview and explicit retention behavior. Replace source identity-provider password assumptions with the approved recovery-key protocol.
Persist secrets only through reviewed device storage; lock/background/failed-network behavior must clear usable in-memory state promptly.

Audit identity leakage via profile photos, household/member/wallet names, finance text, files, analytics, IP/timing metadata, notifications and providers. Explain pseudonymity and irreversible key loss accurately.
Persist owner-managed reporting preferences and default person-split ratios with version checks; changing defaults never rewrites historical money.

issues.title: [Epic] Add household membership and verified sharing
issues.outcome: Let owners invite and revoke members without exposing private profile details to the server.
acceptance: Define migration from personal ownership to explicit household membership and owner/member role checks without granting broad access implicitly.
Bind expiring single-use invites to the intended pseudonymous recipient; prevent replay, key substitution and cross-household access.
Share only user-approved identity fields using recipient-verified encryption envelopes. Membership alone must not unlock private profiles or share the master recovery key.
Revoke future API/file/feed/job access promptly with two-user concurrent tests; disclose that prior recipients can retain data already copied. Restricted child roles remain undecided.

issues.title: [Epic] Complete navigation, drafts and accessible forms
issues.outcome: Reach each in-scope feature through Beranda/Keuangan/Kalender/Lainnya consistently on web, Android and iOS.
acceptance: Implement menu search separately from record search; deep links and native back navigation resolve the correct scoped screen.
Preserve valid drafts across navigation; make loading, empty, retry, saved and conflict states distinct; prevent double submission.
Use Indonesian labels and shared design tokens with platform-native components, safe areas, focus/error associations, keyboard access and large text.
Test 320–1920px web layouts and native navigation; never persist recovery keys/profile plaintext in generic draft storage.

issues.title: [Epic] Complete wallet types and audited balances
issues.outcome: Model cash, bank, e-wallet, credit and external wallets with explicit ownership and audited opening/adjustment operations.
acceptance: Support names/icons, wealth inclusion and archive while retaining historical references; review identity-bearing labels under the privacy policy.
Opening state and adjustments produce purpose-tagged journals with reasons, never balance overwrites.
Keep credit limit, outstanding, available balance and overpayment credit distinct: limit10000/outstanding2000 -> available8000.
Reject inaccessible wallets and conflicting updates; reconcile every displayed balance to journals across all clients.

issues.title: [Epic] Post atomic transfers and credit repayments
issues.outcome: Move principal between accessible wallets atomically and account for fees separately.
acceptance: Transfer1000 with fee50 produces source−1050 and destination+1000; fee is expense and principal internal movement.
Reject identical wallets, cross-household wallets and invalid precision/overflow before mutation.
Credit repayment reduces cash and liability together; explicit overpayment creates CR rather than an erroneous negative liability.
Use deterministic lock order and one durable business-operation identity; concurrent retries, rollback and grouped display cannot duplicate effects.

issues.title: [Epic] Add transaction metadata, corrections and exact splits
issues.outcome: Extend current income/expense capture with reviewed splits and domain-consistent corrections.
acceptance: Add date/time, merchant, description, need/want, member, category and fee with version-protected metadata edits and duplicate-to-draft.
Money edits create a linked reversal/replacement; coordinate originating debt/asset/grocery/service records and postings atomically.
Split1234.56 exactly as617.28+617.28; deterministic largest-remainder allocation preserves one-cent remainders. Reject excess precision and overflow.
Preserve retry identity across refresh failure; reviewed totals/destination/direction match saved records on all clients.
Refine category master-data children before category-based splits; budget-period children follow transaction accounting, avoiding a transactions/budgets dependency cycle.

issues.title: [Epic] Deliver stable searchable transaction history
issues.outcome: Find and inspect transactions with stable pagination and consistent filters.
acceptance: Search merchant/description and filter date/category/member/wallet/type; reset restores documented defaults.
Stable date/amount sorting and scoped cursors produce no duplicate or missing rows under the defined concurrent-write policy.
Group transfer legs as one business operation; show corrections, fee breakdown and original operation lineage.
Match web/native behavior, empty/error states and authorized CSV/report drill-through; log no searched financial descriptions.

issues.title: [Epic] Build category hierarchy and budget cycles
issues.outcome: Plan category spending without losing historical meaning when categories change.
acceptance: Support parent plus one subcategory level, icon/color/default need-want, optional wallet restrictions and archive.
Support period amounts, due dates, cycle-start days1–28, list/card/reorder with accessible controls and version conflicts.
Define category migration from existing free-text values; retain old transaction attribution and reject invalid hierarchy/cross-household mappings.
Explain included cashflow in trend labels; reconcile period actuals to economic-purpose reports at timezone boundaries.

issues.title: [Epic] Implement debt and receivable lifecycles
issues.outcome: Track principal, interest and fees without inflating ordinary spending or allowing overpayment races.
acceptance: Support borrowing/lending/credit-goods origins, prior balances, tenor/rate/due dates and explicit optional wallet effects.
Lend2000, receive500 => remaining1500; payment1501 fails atomically. Concurrent payments cannot overpay the current remainder.
Principal/interest/fee post distinctly; archive/restore preserves all balances and correction lineage.
Privacy-review person/notes fields; reminders prepare an editable message and do not send it automatically.

issues.title: [Epic] Implement savings reservations and goal progress
issues.outcome: Reserve existing funds and show goal progress without minting wealth or double-debiting wallets.
acceptance: Require name/type/target; allow deadline/default wallet, contribution, release and cross-wallet movement with explicit previews.
Reserve1500 from100000 => wallet100000, free cash98500; release500 => reservation1000.
Concurrent reservations lock/check available free cash and reject insufficiency; archive/correction preserves ledger consistency.
Define asset-link interface: linked market value adds to goal progress, while household wealth counts each asset once; complete asset tests with investments epic.

issues.title: [Epic] Reconcile period reports, Excel and print
issues.outcome: Present balances and economic-purpose totals consistently across UI and exported reports.
acceptance: Support day/week/month/year/custom periods in explicit household timezone and category/member/wallet/need-want/budget breakdowns.
Exclude internal transfers, opening balances and reservations from ordinary income/spending; separate debt principal, interest and fees.
UI, print and Excel share identical filters and exact totals; guard spreadsheet formula injection and scope authorized download access.
IDR remains bookkeeping currency; optional display conversion shows timestamp/source/base amounts and never rewrites accepted money.

issues.title: [Epic] Build private files, jobs and transactional outbox
issues.outcome: Provide the authorized file and job substrate needed by receipts, imports, exports and reminders.
acceptance: Enforce configured20MiB/type/signature limits and malware/quarantine checks; strip/review metadata, use short-lived authorized downloads.
Validate ownership for uploads, polling, cancellation and result downloads; reject revoked members and expired links.
Commit domain work and outbox records atomically; at-least-once workers deduplicate delivery, expose terminal failure/retry/cancel states.
Set content/log retention, redaction and cleanup; recover interrupted workers and orphaned uploads without leaking receipts or profile fields.

issues.title: [Epic] Add reviewed text and receipt capture
issues.outcome: Create editable transaction drafts from text, receipts and transfer proofs; never post unreviewed extraction.
acceptance: Support explicit provider consent, uncertainty markers, original-file linkage and manual correction before commit.
Test batches of1–10 files and reject11; per-file failures remain visible and retryable rather than silently disappearing.
Distinguish transfer proof from spending and preserve exact decimal values/categories/wallet selection through review.
Keep provider keys server-side and profile secrets client-side; redact request logs, bound retries/timeouts and prevent duplicate reviewed commits.

issues.title: [Epic] Add reviewed recurring transaction templates
issues.outcome: Schedule monthly/yearly templates that open a review before recording one occurrence.
acceptance: Store amount/category/wallet/person/fee and permitted linked debt/goal/asset references with authorization checks.
Occurrence uniqueness survives response-cache expiration; repeated/concurrent reviews cannot commit twice for one due date.
Document day31 clamp and timezone policy; handle edited schedules, archived destinations and explicit corrections.
Automatic posting remains disabled and tracked separately as P2.

issues.title: [Epic] Deliver groceries and atomic selected checkout
issues.outcome: Turn selected grocery items into a reviewed purchase with an explicit wallet or record-only choice.
acceptance: Support sections, order, quantities/unit prices, merchant, recurring needs and immutable purchase/price history.
Preview only selected lines with exact sum; changing live list prices cannot rewrite completed purchase lines.
Checkout commits purchase plus journal atomically; retry/concurrent checkout cannot record the same purchase twice.
Receipt item extraction uses the reviewed-capture workflow; corrections reverse/replace accounting and linked purchase state together.

issues.title: [Epic] Build calendar, tasks and occurrence-safe reminders
issues.outcome: Coordinate dated, timed and undated commitments without mutating an entire recurring series accidentally.
acceptance: Support month/week/day, event/checklist categories, assignees, order/color, time windows, complete/undo and accessible controls.
Separate date-only from timed data; use household timezone, day31 clamp and occurrence/future/all edit scopes.
Record reminder terminal states; target99% eligible jobs terminal within5minutes, report push-provider delivery separately.
Import and read-only feeds require scoped revocable access; one occurrence completion never completes the series.

issues.title: [Epic] Link maintenance history, costs and calendar
issues.outcome: Record vehicle/home/electronics service with explicit financial and reminder consequences.
acceptance: Manage resources, intervals, next-due dates, service/repair history and authorized attachments.
Preview explicit wallet or record-only cost and linked reminder before save.
Atomically create service history and any financial journal; coordinate reminder outbox with the committed result.
Corrections replace linked money and update calendar state consistently; retries and archive retain full history.

issues.title: [Epic] Protect important links with scoped step-up
issues.outcome: Store ordered household links and protect sensitive viewing without exposing PINs.
acceptance: Validate only safe http/https URLs and reject script/data/credential-bearing URLs using one documented policy.
Support name/category/order/create/edit/archive with household isolation.
Require configured step-up for sensitive views; PIN never appears in URLs/logs and unlock scope/expiry is explicit.
Open links with opener isolation; test keyboard/native external-browser behavior and failed step-up throttling.

issues.title: [Epic] Implement previewed imports, selective export and backup jobs
issues.outcome: Move data in and out with explicit scope, repeatable validation and atomic commit.
acceptance: Version templates; provide row-specific Indonesian errors and proposed category/wallet mappings before committing a preview hash.
Preserve321.09 exactly; reject negative expense inputs and stale/tampered previews; batch rollback leaves no partial rows.
Persist source fingerprints beyond24-hour cache TTL; repeated imports require explicit resolution rather than duplicate postings.
Select only in-scope domains for export; authorize job downloads and exclude recovery keys/profile plaintext. Test formula injection and restore reconciliation.

issues.title: [Epic] Implement investment lots, valuation and trades
issues.outcome: Track units, remaining cost basis and market value independently from cashflow and goal reservations.
acceptance: Support specified asset classes with class-specific units/pricing, ownership and goal links; provenance timestamps identify approximate valuations.
Buy2@1000, value1500/unit, sell1@1500 => remaining units1/cost1000/value1500/realized gain500 before fees.
Correct units to1.5 while preserving remaining cost1000 and a reason; concurrent sales cannot oversell.
Account for purchase/sale fees, dividend/income and corrections atomically; linked goals and household wealth count assets once.

issues.title: [Epic] Apply exact income and asset allocation plans
issues.outcome: Preview exact planned shares and atomically apply period budget limits without implicitly moving money.
acceptance: Keep income allocation and asset target allocation as separate models; goal/asset targets are planning references, not authority to reserve or trade.
Require total 100% before apply; largest-remainder shares sum exactly to accepted principal, including one-cent cases.
Preview exact period budget-limit changes and reject stale versions. Goal reservations require a separate reviewed goal command; asset trades are never implicit.
Atomic idempotent apply cannot leave partial budget-limit updates under concurrent requests or failure.

issues.title: [Epic] Add versioned loan and education scenarios
issues.outcome: Save explainable planning calculations and create goal drafts without posting money automatically.
acceptance: Support fixed/tiered loan rates, extra payments and takeover comparison with explicit assumptions and rounding.
Zero-rate1200000/12 =>100000; test boundary rates/tenors and invalid inputs with versioned deterministic results.
Support education inflation and funding estimates; show assumptions rather than presenting forecasts as guarantees.
Create an editable goal draft from a selected scenario and preserve its formula version/provenance.

issues.title: [Epic] Add period dashboard, notifications and explainable insights
issues.outcome: Show current finances and agenda with clear reporting periods and authorized notifications.
acceptance: Support period/wallet filters, today's agenda, recent entries and accessible amount masking.
Persist notification read state; review push payloads so identity/finance details are not sent without explicit policy.
Generated insights cite period and underlying totals; separate consent for provider processing and aggregate analytics.
Loading/error/empty states match all clients. Optional weather is separately gated with manual-location fallback.

issues.title: [Epic] Add optional consented Sheets and provider integrations
issues.outcome: Connect optional external providers with revocable least-privilege consent.
acceptance: Define provider identity-disclosure boundaries before enabling OAuth; never imply third parties cannot correlate an account.
Use least scopes, encrypted provider-token storage, explicit export selection and disconnect/revoke behavior.
Exercise provider sandbox expiry, outage,429,partial response, callback replay and retries without duplicate bookkeeping.
Keep provider features separately disabled until credentials, privacy review and operational ownership are established.

issues.title: [Epic] Isolate affiliate commissions and payouts
issues.outcome: Track a participant's referrals and payout lifecycle with separate operator authority and explicit identity disclosure.
acceptance: Own referral links/history only; household role never grants commission administration or payout authority.
Available amount excludes pending/paid/reversed commission; configurable default minimum withdrawal50000IDR.
Payout destinations/KYC can reveal identity: approve storage, access, retention and disclosure before enabling payouts.
Provider effects and webhooks have durable idempotency; test concurrent withdrawals, reversals, partial failures and operator audit.

issues.title: [Epic] Publish accurate help and privacy-separated feedback
issues.outcome: Explain the actual product and separate public feedback from private household records.
acceptance: Localize FAQ/about/privacy/terms and recovery/lock/PIN/currency guidance; text must match implemented behavior.
Provide feedback topic/status/search/my-requests with at most one vote per pseudonymous account.
Use distinct public submissions and operator moderation permissions; never copy profile or household finance into public content implicitly.
Cover keyboard/screen-reader interactions and abuse/error states; store policy versions shown to users.

issues.title: [Epic] Complete measured pilot and production release gates
issues.outcome: Release only an explicitly selected, evidenced scope with accountable operational owners.
acceptance: Record independently reviewed crypto/privacy, two-household isolation, journal reconciliation, provider-failure cases and zero unresolved P0/P1 data-integrity defects.
Measure all core flows on web320–1920px, keyboard/screen reader/contrast and native large text/physical devices; cover supported browsers and native lifecycle races.
Declare dataset/concurrency for p95 read<500ms/write<1s excluding providers; configure measured99.9% availability target and redacted observability.
Exercise restore with proposed RPO24h/RTO4h, signed Android/iOS distribution, HTTPS/CSP, incident/rollback runbooks and named release owners.
Pilot expense capture target:90% complete unaided, median<45s; validate full activation with first wallet, transaction and budget/goal. Do not treat proposed targets as measured results.

issues.title: [Epic] Opt-in automatic recurring posting (P2)
issues.outcome: Evaluate automatic posting only after reviewed recurrence is reliable and the product explicitly approves the enhancement.
acceptance: Require opt-in, previewed schedules, revocation/kill switch and visible upcoming/failed occurrences.
Maintain permanent due-date uniqueness and domain invariants under retries, outages and timezone changes.
Define insufficient-funds and archived-wallet behavior; no silent partial processing.
Do not enable or include in core release scope without a separate rollout decision.

issues.title: [Epic] Optional weather and display-currency providers
issues.outcome: Refine optional convenience providers only after core financial behavior is stable.
acceptance: Offer manual location; do not require precise location or identify a household through unnecessary telemetry.
Choose supported display currencies and timestamped quotation providers through an explicit product decision.
Always show IDR base amounts/rate provenance; unavailable providers cannot alter saved money or block core flows.
Gate rollout independently and document provider data/retention.

issues.title: Review and integrate the locally validated monorepo baseline
issues.outcome: Review the existing local first slice and obtain actual revision-linked integration evidence.
acceptance: Review /api /web /mobile plus migrations, compose, protocol, contracts and docs; verify ai-analyze checksums and avoid committing local credentials/artifacts.
Run documented Rust, web, database, real-HTTP/browser and native validation on the candidate revision; record exact unrun gates.
Open an appropriately scoped PR and obtain remote API/web/Android/iOS CI results; distinguish local passes from hosted CI.
Require normal repository review/merge process; this issue does not itself authorize production deployment.

issues.title: Enforce strict TypeScript and resolve checked-boundary errors
issues.outcome: Apply strict compiler checks to application, tests and Next configuration without weakening the rules.
acceptance: Retain strict:true and enable noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, noImplicitReturns, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch, noImplicitOverride, noPropertyAccessFromIndexSignature and forceConsistentCasingInFileNames.
Check next.config.ts and environment declarations; fix unchecked recovery/money parsing, optional fields and typed fetch mocks without suppressions.
Pass npm --prefix web run typecheck, npm --prefix web test and npm --prefix web run build; ensure make check/CI invoke the compiler.
Local implementation completed2026-09-27: typecheck,42 tests and static production build pass. Await repository review/integration; not marked Done.

issues.title: Enforce runtime contract and cross-client crypto fixtures in CI
issues.outcome: Prevent API/client drift and cryptographic interoperability regressions on every candidate revision.
acceptance: Generate/check contracts/openapi.json from the runtime and validate OpenAPI3.1; never use the unimplemented source catalog as a live client contract.
Run independent shared HKDF/AES-GCM/Ed25519 fixtures in web, Rust, Android and iOS and verify error/version behavior.
Exercise owner-isolation and invalid-envelope/signature cases; bound logs to nonsensitive test evidence.
Provide actual hosted-CI run links covering all platforms; split platform-specific CI changes into separate follow-up tickets if runner constraints require them.

issues.title: Test iOS authentication and background lifecycle races
issues.outcome: Turn source-reviewed Swift lifecycle fixes into deterministic regression evidence.
acceptance: Test background during create/recover, delayed old login/revoke after newer sign-in and lock during in-flight network requests.
Assert cancelled work cannot repopulate keys/profile/UI and newer sessions are not revoked by stale cleanup.
Test committed transaction followed by failed refresh: saved status and retry identity cannot duplicate the journal.
Run Swift tests plus simulator UI/lifecycle harness and preserve redacted failure artifacts.

issues.title: Test Android authentication and background lifecycle races
issues.outcome: Prove Kotlin lifecycle and retry state are safe under delayed transport and app backgrounding.
acceptance: Test background during create/recover, delayed response after a newer sign-in and immediate lock during in-flight requests.
Assert stale coroutines cannot restore sensitive state or revoke a newer session.
Test committed write then failed refresh with stable idempotency identity and user-visible committed status.
Run JVM and instrumented lifecycle tests on an emulator with redacted evidence.

issues.title: Specify credential rotation, device enrollment and revocation
issues.outcome: Write a reviewable protocol before implementing persistent credentials or changing key material.
acceptance: Specify atomic profile re-encryption/signing-key rotation, all-device revocation, envelope versions and interrupted-operation recovery.
Define separately scoped device credentials, enrollment proof, trusted-key verification and removal; never transfer a master key through the server.
Document lost-key behavior, rollback/retry semantics, old-key rejection and cross-platform test vectors.
Record independent security review findings and resolve critical/high protocol findings before dependent implementation begins.

issues.title: Implement owner-wide session revocation
issues.outcome: Allow a fresh owner proof to revoke all sessions reliably under concurrent requests.
acceptance: Add an explicit scoped operation to the runtime OpenAPI with freshness/step-up proof requirements and bounded errors.
Invalidate sessions atomically, including concurrent issuance under the chosen epoch/locking strategy; verify already revoked tokens fail.
Test cross-owner attempts, replay, expiry and cache outage; PostgreSQL remains authoritative.
Return only public status; no token or profile details in audit logs. Client entry points are separate refinements under the security epic.

issues.title: Specify account erasure and retention boundaries
issues.outcome: Make destructive account actions and their privacy consequences explicit before coding deletion.
acceptance: Inventory identity ciphertext, readable ledger, files, jobs, caches, backups, audit records, provider mappings and shared copies.
Define scope preview, fresh step-up, retention/backup expiry and completion evidence; distinguish deleting access from erasing stored records.
Resolve privacy-owner decisions and legal review needs without inventing jurisdictional guarantees.
Produce accepted schema/API/client follow-up tickets and erasure negative-test cases.

issues.title: Implement reviewed Android credential storage
issues.outcome: Support optional native unlock using the reviewed device-credential protocol.
acceptance: Protect device material through Android Keystore and authenticated wrapping; never save raw master keys in preferences, backups, logs or clipboard.
Define biometric/device-credential cancellation, key invalidation, reinstall and background lock behavior.
Cover recovery/enrollment and server revocation with Android tests; retain a deliberate memory-only option.
Pass instrumented device/emulator verification and document security settings and backup exclusions.

issues.title: Implement reviewed iOS credential storage
issues.outcome: Support optional iOS unlock using the reviewed device-credential protocol.
acceptance: Use appropriate Keychain access controls and device-bound accessibility for approved credential material; no raw master in UserDefaults/backups/logs.
Specify biometric changes, locked-device access, cancellation, reinstall and background lock behavior.
Test enrollment/recovery, local removal and remote device revocation; retain a deliberate memory-only option.
Pass simulator and physical-device checks appropriate to Keychain/biometric behavior and document remaining limits.

issues.title: Verify web delivery integrity and telemetry privacy
issues.outcome: Make the production delivery boundary of client encryption and operator-visible metadata explicit.
acceptance: Define/test HTTPS, CSP, dependency integrity, framing/referrer policy and production origin/CORS configuration.
Assert build artifacts/SSR output/logs/analytics contain no profile plaintext, recovery keys, bearer tokens or financial descriptions.
Audit push, file metadata, URLs and provider flows for identity correlation; document active-malicious-client-delivery limitations.
Attach staging header/config evidence and threat-model findings before enabling public traffic.

issues.title: Execute a disposable PostgreSQL backup and restore drill
issues.outcome: Prove a backup restores complete, authorized and balanced application state in a separate environment.
acceptance: Back up a disposable seeded instance and restore to a new isolated PostgreSQL environment without overwriting existing user data.
Verify migrations, restricted runtime roles, owner isolation, journals, profile ciphertext and durable idempotency after restore.
Measure achieved RPO/RTO against proposed24h/4h targets and record encrypted backup/key storage and access policy.
Document repeatable commands, failure recovery and cleanup with a named operational owner.

issues.title: Specify and test authentication abuse and step-up controls
issues.outcome: Bound public authentication abuse and define sensitive-action authorization separately from a local UI lock.
acceptance: Define challenge TTL/use limits, registration/auth rate limits, privacy-preserving counters and bounded abuse errors.
Specify fresh-proof step-up scopes for links, destructive actions, rotation and provider changes; never treat a client-only PIN as server authorization.
Test replay, parallel attempts, lockout recovery and throttling outage behavior without identifier enumeration.
Implement one reviewed API control slice and create separate remaining client/control tickets before expanding the change.

issues.title: Resolve release scope, ownership and provider decisions
issues.outcome: Assign product/security/engineering/QA/operations decision owners and refine the next bounded work packages.
acceptance: Confirm capacity and target-release subset before assigning issue dates/estimates; preserve the existing project target as a planning horizon.
Decide invitation policy, retention, supported display currencies, quotation/OCR providers and affiliate disclosure/payment constraints.
Keep restricted child roles undecided and excluded modules out of scope; optional integrations and P2 automatic posting stay disabled.
Split broad epics into API/schema, web, Android, iOS and integration/rollout children with independent acceptance criteria; target1–3 engineering days per implementation task where credible.
